name: Abhyanga Body Oil
short_description: A warming daily massage oil to nourish skin and support a grounded routine.
description: A slow infusion of sesame oil and traditional Ayurvedic botanicals created for the daily practice of self-massage. Its warming character helps soften the skin while turning an everyday ritual into a quiet moment of care.
usage: Warm a small amount between the palms. Massage over the body with long strokes on the limbs and circular movements at the joints. Leave for 15–20 minutes before bathing.

name: Tulsi Calm Tea
short_description: A fragrant caffeine-free infusion for unhurried afternoons and restful evenings.
description: A gentle blend led by tulsi, the much-loved Ayurvedic herb traditionally used to support resilience and clarity. Balanced with warming spices, it makes a comforting cup at any time of day.
usage: Steep one teaspoon in freshly boiled water for 5–7 minutes. Strain and enjoy without milk, or add a little honey once the tea has cooled slightly.

name: Amla Chyawanprash
short_description: A traditional herbal preserve made with amla and aromatic restorative spices.
description: A rich, slow-cooked herbal preparation centred on amla. This traditional preserve brings together fruit, ghee, honey, and spices in a deeply aromatic daily tonic inspired by classical Ayurvedic practice.
usage: Enjoy one teaspoon in the morning, followed by warm water or milk. If you are pregnant, taking medication, or managing a health condition, consult your practitioner first.

name: Shanti Night Serum
short_description: A silky botanical face oil designed for a calming end-of-day ritual.
description: A lightweight evening blend that cushions the skin with botanical oils and a subtle herbaceous aroma. A few drops invite slower breathing, gentle facial massage, and a softer transition into rest.
usage: After cleansing, press 2–3 drops onto slightly damp face and neck. Massage gently with upward movements. Use in the evening and avoid the immediate eye area.
